Prune correlated (environmental) variables.

prune_envs.Rd

Conducts pruning of envirnonmental values according to correlation by removing the variable correlated with the most other variables iteratively until no correlated pairs remain. Ties removed at random.

Usage

prune_envs(
  envs,
  r2 = 0.7,
  scale = TRUE,
  seed = floor(stats::runif(1, 1, 10000))
)

Arguments

envs

numeric matrix/data.frame/data.table of

r2

numeric, default 0.7. Threshold to use for prunning; correlations (cor) values higher than r2 will result in the removal of envs.

scale

logical, default TRUE. If TRUE, environmental vairables will be scaled to mean 0, sd 1. This is recommended for subsequent model fitting by mechGEA.

seed

integer, default a random number between 1 and 10,000. Seed to use for breaking ties.
